sources.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Introduced few-shot chain-of-thought prompting and showed large gains on arithmetic/symbolic/common-sense reasoning for sufficiently capable models.
sources.limits: Older model regime; current reasoning models may not benefit from explicit CoT prompts.

sources.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Samples multiple reasoning paths and aggregates answers; strong original gains on reasoning benchmarks.
sources.limits: Multiplies inference cost; depends on answer aggregation and diversity.

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts
sources.evidence_notes: Searches over intermediate thought states rather than committing to one chain.
sources.limits: Expensive; evaluator/search quality can dominate.

sources.title: Least-to-Most Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Decomposes a hard problem into easier subproblems solved sequentially.
sources.limits: Can propagate early decomposition errors.

sources.title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Separates plan generation from execution to reduce missing-step errors.
sources.limits: Task/model dependent.

sources.title: PAL: Program-Aided Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Delegates symbolic/arithmetic execution to a program interpreter.
sources.limits: Requires safe execution and correct program generation.

sources.title: Program of Thoughts Prompting
sources.evidence_notes: Separates reasoning from computation using generated programs.
sources.limits: Sandboxing and verifier needed.

sources.title: ReAct
sources.evidence_notes: Interleaves reasoning, actions, and observations for grounded interactive tasks.
sources.limits: Long loops can be costly and error-prone.

sources.title: Reflexion
sources.evidence_notes: Uses feedback and episodic verbal reflection to improve later attempts.
sources.limits: Benefits depend on useful external/task feedback; reflection alone is not proof.

sources.title: Self-Refine
sources.evidence_notes: Same model generates, critiques, and revises outputs iteratively.
sources.limits: Critical literature shows intrinsic self-correction can also worsen outputs.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.evidence_notes: Shows prompted self-correction without reliable external feedback can degrade reasoning.
sources.limits: Result is task/model specific but important counterevidence.

sources.title: When Can LLMs Actually Correct Their Own Mistakes?
sources.evidence_notes: Critical survey distinguishing intrinsic self-correction from correction with reliable external feedback.
sources.limits: Broad literature synthesis rather than a single universal bound.

sources.title: DSPy
sources.evidence_notes: Treats LM pipelines declaratively and compiles prompts/demonstrations against metrics.
sources.limits: Optimization can overfit weak metrics.

sources.title: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO)
sources.evidence_notes: Uses an LLM to generate candidate solutions/prompts and objective feedback to iteratively optimize.
sources.limits: Needs trustworthy objective and holdout.

sources.title: Automatic Prompt Engineer
sources.evidence_notes: Generates and selects candidate instructions automatically.
sources.limits: Search cost and benchmark overfit risk.

sources.title: PromptBreeder
sources.evidence_notes: Evolves task prompts and prompt-mutation prompts.
sources.limits: Can be computationally expensive and overfit task sets.

sources.title: ProTeGi
sources.evidence_notes: Uses natural-language critiques as textual gradients with beam/bandit search.
sources.limits: Requires representative dev set and reliable evaluator.

sources.title: TextGrad
sources.evidence_notes: Backpropagation-like textual feedback across LM pipelines.
sources.limits: Early research; evaluator dependence.

sources.title: OpenAI Reasoning Best Practices
sources.evidence_notes: Current guidance says reasoning models generally benefit from simple/direct goals, constraints, and success criteria; explicit think-step-by-step prompts may hinder.
sources.limits: Provider/model-specific and subject to change.

sources.title: OpenAI Prompting Guide
sources.evidence_notes: Treat prompts as application code: version, test, review, and roll back.
sources.limits: Provider-specific examples.

sources.title: OpenAI Prompt Caching
sources.evidence_notes: Shared stable prefixes can reuse KV work and reduce latency/input cost.
sources.limits: Cache behavior/provider pricing change over time.

sources.title: OpenAI Latency Optimization
sources.evidence_notes: Seven principles include fewer tokens, fewer requests, parallelism, streaming, and not defaulting to an LLM.
sources.limits: Production guidance, not task-quality evidence.

sources.title: OpenAI Structured Outputs
sources.evidence_notes: Schema-constrained outputs improve type/shape reliability and reduce formatting retries.
sources.limits: Supported JSON Schema subset and provider-specific availability.

sources.title: Anthropic Context Engineering
sources.evidence_notes: Treat context as finite and optimize utility; use just-in-time context and lightweight references.
sources.limits: Vendor engineering guidance.

sources.title: Anthropic Writing Effective Tools for Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Tool naming, narrow boundaries, high-signal responses, pagination/filtering, and eval-driven tool descriptions materially affect tool use.
sources.limits: Effects can vary by model.

sources.title: Anthropic Contextual Retrieval
sources.evidence_notes: Combines contextualized chunks, BM25, embeddings, and reranking; reported substantial retrieval-failure reductions.
sources.limits: Vendor experiments and corpus-dependent.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle
sources.evidence_notes: Long-context models can show U-shaped positional sensitivity; relevant information in the middle may be used less effectively.
sources.limits: Performance evolves with newer models; must re-test.

sources.title: LLMLingua
sources.evidence_notes: Learned prompt compression reported large token reductions while preserving task performance in original settings.
sources.limits: Compression can discard hidden constraints; requires task eval.

sources.title: HyDE
sources.evidence_notes: Generates a hypothetical relevant document and embeds it for zero-shot dense retrieval.
sources.limits: Generated assumptions can bias retrieval.

sources.title: Self-RAG
sources.evidence_notes: Trains model to decide when to retrieve and critique relevance/support/utility.
sources.limits: Training-dependent; not a simple runtime prompt.

sources.title: ColBERTv2
sources.evidence_notes: Token-level late interaction improves fine-grained neural retrieval while retaining precomputable document embeddings.
sources.limits: Index/storage and serving complexity.

sources.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
sources.evidence_notes: Graph/community summaries target global corpus sensemaking and relationship-heavy queries.
sources.limits: Expensive indexing and maintenance; often unnecessary for local lookup.

sources.title: RAGAS
sources.evidence_notes: Reference-free RAG metrics for retrieval and faithfulness diagnostics.
sources.limits: Metric/model-judge validity must be calibrated.

sources.title: RAGChecker
sources.evidence_notes: Fine-grained diagnostic framework separating retrieval and generation failure modes.
sources.limits: Evaluation metrics remain proxies for user success.

sources.title: MemGPT
sources.evidence_notes: Virtual-memory metaphor: page information between limited context and external memory tiers.
sources.limits: Architecture is a conceptual reference, not necessarily optimal today.

sources.title: LongMemEval
sources.evidence_notes: Evaluates extraction, cross-session/temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention for long-term assistant memory.
sources.limits: Benchmark distribution differs from personal Agent OS.

sources.title: MemBench
sources.evidence_notes: Evaluates memory effectiveness, efficiency and capacity across multiple memory scenarios.
sources.limits: Recent benchmark; needs local replication.

sources.title: Human-Inspired Memory Architecture for LLM Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Explores consolidation, interference-based forgetting, maturation, reconsolidation, entity graphs and hybrid retrieval; reports strong compression/retention results.
sources.limits: 2026 research; reproduction/generalization needed.

sources.title: PlugMem
sources.evidence_notes: Transforms histories into facts and reusable skills in structured memory.
sources.limits: Recent research; architecture complexity must be justified.

sources.title: MemoryBank
sources.evidence_notes: Uses forgetting-curve-inspired memory decay/reinforcement for long-term conversation.
sources.limits: Biological analogy does not itself validate personal-memory policy.

sources.title: A-MEM
sources.evidence_notes: Zettelkasten-inspired dynamically linked/evolving agent memories.
sources.limits: Recent research; risk of memory graph growth and inference errors.

sources.title: LightMem
sources.evidence_notes: Recent memory architecture separates short/mid/long-term operations and emphasizes offline consolidation/two-stage retrieval.
sources.limits: Catalog URL needs verification before citation; retain as research lead only.

sources.title: Generative Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Observation-memory, reflection and planning architecture for believable long-horizon simulated agents.
sources.limits: Simulation/social-agent result, not proof for productivity agents.

sources.title: Toolformer
sources.evidence_notes: Self-supervised training to decide which APIs to call, when, and with what arguments.
sources.limits: Requires training; APIs/tasks limited in original work.

sources.title: ART: Automatic Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-use
sources.evidence_notes: Automatically constructs task programs from demonstrations and tool libraries.
sources.limits: Library quality and execution safety matter.

sources.title: MRKL Systems
sources.evidence_notes: Routes natural-language problems to modular symbolic/neural experts.
sources.limits: Router errors and module interface design are key.

sources.title: ReWOO
sources.evidence_notes: Separates planning from observations to reduce repeated token use compared with ReAct-style loops.
sources.limits: Less adaptive when observations should change the plan.

sources.title: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
sources.evidence_notes: Benchmarks function/tool calling including parallel, multiple, and stateful cases.
sources.limits: Leaderboard task mix may not match Agent OS.

sources.title: SWE-bench
sources.evidence_notes: Real GitHub issue resolution benchmark with execution-based verification.
sources.limits: Benchmark contamination and repository subset limitations.

sources.title: SWE-agent Agent-Computer Interfaces
sources.evidence_notes: Shows that the agent-computer interface itself materially affects coding-agent performance.
sources.limits: Specific to software engineering, but broadly relevant to tool UX.

sources.title: BrowseComp
sources.evidence_notes: Hard web-browsing benchmark with short verifiable answers; test-time sampling can improve coverage.
sources.limits: Designed benchmark, not user workload.

sources.title: Anthropic Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Advocates multi-turn/state/environment evaluation and combining grading techniques.
sources.limits: Vendor guidance.

sources.title: OpenAI Evaluation Best Practices
sources.evidence_notes: Continuous evals, representative data, pairwise/pass-fail grading, human calibration and explicit rubrics.
sources.limits: OpenAI-hosted Evals platform itself is being deprecated.

sources.title: Judging the Judges: Position Bias
sources.evidence_notes: 150k+ evaluations show systematic position bias varying by judge/task.
sources.limits: Focuses one bias class; other evaluator biases also matter.

sources.title: Multi-Agent Judge Bias Amplification
sources.evidence_notes: Finds some multi-agent debate judge setups can amplify biases rather than cancel them.
sources.limits: Specific frameworks/tasks.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
sources.evidence_notes: Defines evolving spans/metrics/events for inference, retrieval, memory, tools, plans and agents.
sources.limits: Some agent conventions are still development status.

sources.title: Google SRE Canarying Releases
sources.evidence_notes: Limit blast radius and consume only a bounded fraction of error budget while measuring candidate behavior.
sources.limits: General systems practice; needs adaptation to agent behavior.

sources.title: DPO
sources.evidence_notes: Simplifies preference alignment to classification-like objective without PPO/reward-model loop.
sources.limits: Later work identifies tradeoffs and no universally best preference loss.

sources.title: KTO
sources.evidence_notes: Uses desirable/undesirable binary feedback and prospect-theoretic utility; reports competitive preference alignment.
sources.limits: Best inductive bias depends on setting.

sources.title: SimPO
sources.evidence_notes: Reference-free preference optimization using average sequence log-probability reward.
sources.limits: Preference optimization remains dataset/eval sensitive.

sources.title: Constitutional AI
sources.evidence_notes: Principles guide critique/revision and AI-generated preference feedback.
sources.limits: Constitution choice and evaluator failure remain governance issues.

sources.title: RLAIF vs RLHF
sources.evidence_notes: Reports AI-feedback alignment comparable to RLHF on studied tasks, with human evaluation of final policies.
sources.limits: Reward-model validation alone was imperfect; final policy must be evaluated.

sources.title: InstructGPT / RLHF
sources.evidence_notes: SFT + human preference reward model + PPO improved instruction following and human preference.
sources.limits: Expensive/complex pipeline and reward misspecification risks.

sources.title: LoRA
sources.evidence_notes: Low-rank trainable adapters reduce trainable parameters/memory while maintaining quality in original experiments.
sources.limits: Rank/target-module/task choices need eval.

sources.title: QLoRA
sources.evidence_notes: 4-bit frozen base + LoRA greatly reduces fine-tuning memory in original work.
sources.limits: Quantization/training-stack complexity; eval judge limitations noted by authors.

sources.title: LIMA
sources.evidence_notes: Shows strong alignment behavior from only 1k curated examples on a strong pretrained model.
sources.limits: Does not imply small data always wins; capability largely inherited from pretraining.

sources.title: AlpaGasus
sources.evidence_notes: LLM-filtered 9k subset outperformed training on noisy 52k Alpaca set in reported evals.
sources.limits: Strong-model filtering can import judge bias.

sources.title: LESS
sources.evidence_notes: Gradient-similarity selection using 5% of instruction data often outperformed full data for targeted capabilities.
sources.limits: Higher selection complexity; targeted not universal.

sources.title: DoReMi
sources.evidence_notes: Proxy model learns domain mixture weights; reported faster convergence and downstream gains.
sources.limits: Pretraining-scale technique; limited direct Agent OS applicability.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
sources.evidence_notes: Dedup reduced memorization and train-test overlap and achieved equal/better accuracy with fewer steps.
sources.limits: Training-specific, but general dedupe principle transfers to memory/context.

sources.title: The Curse of Recursion / Model Collapse
sources.evidence_notes: Repeated training on generated data can lose distribution tails/model quality.
sources.limits: Does not imply all synthetic data is harmful; provenance/mixing/quality matter.

sources.title: Textbooks Are All You Need
sources.evidence_notes: Curated and synthetic textbook-like data enabled a small coding model to perform strongly in original experiments.
sources.limits: Narrow domain and contamination concerns require care.

sources.title: Distilling Step-by-Step
sources.evidence_notes: Uses teacher rationales as auxiliary supervision for smaller models.
sources.limits: Rationale quality and privacy/provenance matter.

sources.title: Chinchilla Compute-Optimal Training
sources.evidence_notes: Shows compute allocation between parameters and training tokens strongly affects performance.
sources.limits: Specific scaling law estimates evolve with data/model architecture.

sources.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
sources.evidence_notes: Empirical power-law scaling with model/data/compute established systematic optimization framing.
sources.limits: Superseded/refined in some compute-optimal conclusions by later work.

sources.title: FlashAttention
sources.evidence_notes: IO-aware exact attention reduces memory traffic and accelerates transformer workloads.
sources.limits: Hardware/kernel-specific applicability.

sources.title: vLLM / PagedAttention
sources.evidence_notes: PagedAttention and serving scheduler improve KV-cache utilization and throughput.
sources.limits: Self-hosted serving concern; version/hardware dependent.

sources.title: Speculative Decoding
sources.evidence_notes: Draft-model proposals verified by target can accelerate exact-distribution decoding.
sources.limits: Speedup depends on draft acceptance/hardware/batch regime.

sources.title: Medusa
sources.evidence_notes: Multiple decoding heads propose future tokens and tree verification reduces serial decoding steps.
sources.limits: Requires model augmentation/fine-tuning.

sources.title: GPTQ
sources.evidence_notes: One-shot low-bit weight quantization reduces memory and can speed local inference.
sources.limits: Accuracy/speed depend on model, kernel and hardware.

sources.title: SmoothQuant
sources.evidence_notes: Training-free W8A8 post-training quantization with reported speed/memory benefits.
sources.limits: Primarily data-center GPU inference.

sources.title: OpenAI Rate Limit Guidance
sources.evidence_notes: Honor Retry-After; bounded exponential backoff with jitter; avoid nested retries and retrying non-transient errors.
sources.limits: Provider-specific error semantics.

sources.title: Google Gemini Context Caching
sources.evidence_notes: Large common prompt prefixes increase implicit cache-hit probability; cache tokens are observable.
sources.limits: Provider-specific thresholds and behavior.

sources.title: Microsoft Attention-Sensitive Alerting
sources.evidence_notes: Frames alert value against interruption cost.
sources.limits: Historical work; modern assistant context differs.

sources.title: Need Help? Designing Proactive AI Assistants for Programming
sources.evidence_notes: Modern experimental study of proactive assistant interventions and design tradeoffs.
sources.limits: Programming domain.

sources.title: Magentic-UI
sources.evidence_notes: Co-planning, interruption, sandboxing, allowlists and approval patterns for human-centered web agents.
sources.limits: Experimental system.

sources.title: W3C PROV
sources.evidence_notes: Standard conceptual model of entities, activities, agents and derivation.
sources.limits: May be heavier than Agent OS needs if adopted literally.

sources.title: SLSA Provenance v1.2
sources.evidence_notes: Verifiable build/source provenance model.
sources.limits: Software-artifact scope.

sources.title: Cedar Policy Language
sources.evidence_notes: Deterministic principal/action/resource/context authorization with default-deny-compatible patterns.
sources.limits: Adoption vs simpler custom policy must be benchmarked.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent
sources.evidence_notes: General policy-as-code engine for decoupled authorization decisions.
sources.limits: Operational dependency/complexity.

sources.title: AgentDojo
sources.evidence_notes: Benchmark for prompt injection attacks on tool-using agents.
sources.limits: Attack set evolves with systems.

sources.title: CaMeL: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
sources.evidence_notes: Separates trusted control flow from untrusted data and uses capability-oriented enforcement.
sources.limits: Research architecture; integration complexity.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.evidence_notes: Current agent-specific threat taxonomy.
sources.limits: Industry consensus document, not empirical benchmark.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF
sources.evidence_notes: Risk-management framework for AI systems.
sources.limits: Broad governance, not implementation prescription.

sources.title: NIST SSDF
sources.evidence_notes: Secure software-development practices including provenance, secure environments, and root-cause learning.
sources.limits: General software security.

sources.title: Google SRE Error Budget Policy
sources.evidence_notes: Uses reliability budget to decide when feature velocity must yield to reliability work.
sources.limits: Must adapt service SLO concepts to agent quality/safety.

sources.title: Google SRE Eliminating Toil
sources.evidence_notes: Defines repetitive/manual/automatable low-enduring-value work as toil.
sources.limits: Human ops framing.

sources.title: Temporal Durable Execution for AI Agents
sources.evidence_notes: Durable event history/replay and workflow branching address long-running agent failure/replay cost.
sources.limits: Vendor engineering report; adoption should be benchmarked.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Workflows
sources.evidence_notes: Explicit workflows/checkpoints for ordering and recovery; recommends simpler composition first.
sources.limits: Framework-specific.

sources.title: A2A Protocol
sources.evidence_notes: Cross-framework task/capability exchange without sharing internal memory/tools.
sources.limits: Interoperability still evolving.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 Update
sources.evidence_notes: Stateless/cacheable core direction and extension framework including tasks.
sources.limits: Protocol evolves rapidly.
